hierarchy_goals: Explain the operating system and causal process needed for the decision.
negative_space_target: sufficient for native title, semantic objects, and visible source notes
prompt_text: Create a landscape 16:9 full-slide visual reconstruction target for role process_explainer. This is visual truth only, never the final slide surface. Composition requirements: diagram-led technical editorial composition, clear directional process, visible component relationships, native connector and label space, bounded technical illustration. Treat the linked Semantic Sidecar as the sole authority for exact wording, numbers, units, data, citations, accessibility, and native/raster policy. Reserve clean native reconstruction regions for title, subtitle, labels, body, structured data, citations, footer, and page number. Prefer no rendered text beyond large generic semantic labels. No paragraphs, full citations, tiny source notes, dense table text, tiny chart labels, pseudo-language, invented numbers, quotations, logos, watermarks, screenshots, dashboard walls, or full-slide raster background. Do not render digits, numerals, numbered labels, percentages, dates, quantities, or any other numeric characters; use unlabeled geometry or alphabetic placeholders only. Render one single process-explainer slide composition only. Exclude design-board samples, palettes, typography specimens, module cards, layout miniatures, legends about the design system, and multiple slide thumbnails. Use one dominant left-to-right process across the main canvas, one bounded visual frame, one clean title band, one source-note footer, and large open native-text regions.
